Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. The group address import/export layer is the CSV/XML/OPC readers and writers: the CSV column builder escapes the separator characters, the operation pairs the export selections with SetDescription, the CSV reader creates the line reader/writer by name and rejects an unsupported format with InvalidImportData, the XML reader reads the group range and group address attributes (Name, Address, RangeStart/RangeEnd, Central, Unfiltered, Description, DPTs, Security) and reports schema errors through the import validation result, and the OPC export writes its .phd streams with the '{0}/{1}' or '{0}/{1}/{2}' addresses.
